title: Folder
slide_intent: Teach how a pocket folder can introduce a research story on the outside and organize supporting material inside.
strategic_value: CSAIL can make a packet of separate documents read as a laboratory publication through repeated warm tones, research imagery and the mark.
demonstration: A slim portrait cover overlaps an opened folder. A strip of tinted photographs runs down the cover; interior panels combine text, image fields and a colored pocket.
practical_value: Keep the exterior readable at a glance and move denser mission or research information into the interior.

content_islands.name: Format explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the folder purpose and contact guidance in the left column.

content_islands.name: Closed cover
content_islands.spec: Tilt the closed cover over the left part of the open spread. Put the mark in the white area beside a vertical image strip.

content_islands.name: Open interior
content_islands.spec: Show both inside panels and the pocket at the foot, using tinted imagery and separate text blocks.
